plain: Pay or benefit gained from holding an office

webster.text: The profit arising from office or employment; that which is received as a compensation for services, or which is annexed to the possession of office, as salary, fees and perquisites.

example.quote: That article which leaves it in the power of the legislature to ascertain its own emolument is one to which I allude.
example.cite: James Madison, Speeches in Congress, June 1789, as transcribed at constitution.org (the page is dated June 8, 1789; the House removal debate ran June 16-22, 1789, and his amendments were offered June 8)
